SEARCH
Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class BrowserSettings

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.BrowserSettings
public class BrowserSettings extends Object
Application-wide browser preferences, persisted as JSON by BrowserStore and applied to every WebEngine the panel creates.

The defaults aim for a usable, private-ish modern browser: DuckDuckGo as the search fallback, JavaScript and cookies on, no custom user agent (so sites see the real WebKit one), and history capped at 500 entries. The search engine is stored by name (not as an enum) so a hand-edited or newer settings file with an unknown engine degrades to SearchEngine.DUCKDUCKGO instead of failing to parse.
